verdict.rationale: Bevy is not a hosted service at all — it is a fully open-source (MIT/Apache 2.0) Rust engine that ships as source code you compile and run entirely on your own machine, with no contracts, license fees, or vendor cloud dependency (bevy-docs-18, bevy-docs-25, bevy-docs-32, bevy-docs-35, bevy-docs-21). Community corroborates the open, no-strings-attached nature of the license (bevy-comm-2). Missing for 10: no explicit 'self-hosting' documentation or deployment guide since the concept doesn't apply the same way as for SaaS products, and no independent verification of running it in constrained/offline environments.
